findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1193 checks full git status after the bounded metadata commit and throws before merging main into the story worktree. With any unrelated unstaged or untracked main-branch change, story_create --fromDraft commits the bounded metadata, then fails at this full-worktree cleanliness check, so the story/worktree have already been created but story/B-* does not receive the main metadata commit. This violates the bounded-staging/failure-behavior contract: either require a clean worktree before mutation, or only validate the bounded metadata paths and still merge main into the story branch while preserving unrelated user changes.

packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1563-1575 calls handlers.story_create() and handlers.dev_start() before commitFromDraftMetadataAndMergeMain(), while 1155-1169 only checks for a dirty git index after those mutations have already happened. Repro: with an unrelated staged main-branch edit, story_create --fromDraft aborts on "requires a clean git index" but leaves the draft deleted in the working tree, creates .koala/story/actives/B-*, and registers .worktrees/B-* on story/B-*. This still violates the draft-to-active transaction contract: unrelated user changes are preserved, but the command fails open instead of either rejecting staged dirt before any mutation or completing the bounded metadata commit + main merge generically.
